basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old from a small town in Oregon, currently working as a barista at a local coffee shop. I recently moved back home after finishing college, where I majored in Environmental Science. I enjoy listening to Mac Miller, learning about military tactics, and watching bunny videos in my downtime. I'm single and spend my evenings browsing Reddit and playing video games. My typical online hours are late evenings after my work shift ends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, which has given me a basic understanding of ecological systems and sustainable practices. My interest in the Navy SEALs comes from a fascination with their rigorous training and discipline, which I admire but have no personal experience with.
